race.comment: ALABAMA CHARM (5) made it three wins from her last five starts when she finished a shade too well at Warwick Farm over today's distance 17 days ago. Progressive mare who shows no signs of letting up deep into the prep. Must go on top back at the provincials. DAWN OR DUSK (7) came from last to get up for third when resuming over 1450m at the Illawarra Grange circuit last time out. Sparingly raced mare who has never raced beyond 1500m but it looks the right move now. SUR NOVA CENTAURI (3) started at $1.60 first-up over 1400m at Hawkesbury and opened his Australian account with a dominant display. Promising gelding who should eat up the extra 200m. TEQUISODA (1) started favourite but missed the frame when resuming over 1400m last time out. Good second-up performer who should be far more effective out to this trip. FLYING ARABESQUE (2) returned to form in a similar race here at his latest appearance. Can build on that performance.
